finding: A public WorldAdapter.tick call attempts the same per-instance lock while a describe-scene converse transaction is paused. It does not enter the protected method body until conversation finishes. Across three source-stable workers, the conversation lifecycle and baseline reply remain intact, tick completes, and neither thread raises.
limits: One public-method pair and schedule only. Direct native object access, other adapter methods, multi-adapter sharing, autonomous workers, other schedules, and performance impact remain unverified.
